description_en: Creates a C2PA content credential signing task for batch processing objects under a specified prefix in an OSS bucket
description_zh: 创建一个用于批量处理OSS Bucket内指定前缀下对象的C2PA内容凭证签名任务
name: CreateC2paBucketSignTask

parameters.help_en: The region where the OSS bucket resides. This value must match the actual region of the bucket
parameters.help_zh: 用户OSS Bucket所在地域，必须与Bucket的实际地域一致
parameters.name: bucket_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. You must grant the service-linked role AliyunServiceRoleForAIDeepSign access to the bucket in advance
parameters.help_zh: 用户OSS Bucket名称。需提前授权服务关联角色AliyunServiceRoleForAIDeepSign访问
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: The source object prefix. The prefix must be `ai-deepsign/` or a subdirectory under it. The service recursively processes objects with the .jpg, .jpeg, .png, or .mp4 file extension
parameters.help_zh: 源对象前缀。必须为ai-deepsign/或其子目录，服务将递归处理其中扩展名为.jpg、.jpeg、.png或.mp4的对象
parameters.name: source_prefix

parameters.help_en: The content source type. This parameter is optional and is not supported in the current version
parameters.help_zh: 可选的内容来源类型，当前版本暂不支持
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the software that generated the content. This parameter is optional and is not supported in the current version
parameters.help_zh: 可选的生成内容软件名称，当前版本暂不支持
parameters.name: software_agent

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the bucket batch signing task. You can use this ID to query, pause, resume, or stop the task
TaskId.description_zh: Bucket批量签名任务ID，可用于查询、暂停、恢复或终止任务
TaskId.title_en: Bucket批量签名任务ID，可用于查询、暂停、恢复或终止任务
TaskId.title_zh: Bucket批量签名任务ID，可用于查询、暂停、恢复或终止任务
